decisions: Use cp as the permanent two-character GitHub Copilot agent ID.
Use Copilot's existing interactive TUI and Agent Skills support rather than adding an ACP runtime.
Make model auto the effective default for every task and complexity tier while retaining a populated named-model picker.
Keep transcript, cost, token, resume, and ACP integration out of the first release.
Keep cp out of the default Fleet roster until it has benchmark and reliability evidence.
constraints: Feature creation only; do not start or implement F743 in this workflow.
Use .agents/skills for Copilot commands and preserve consumer-owned AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and README.md.
Named model availability varies by Copilot plan and organization policy.
The public repository must contain no credentials, tokens, or private account details.
Preserve the unrelated in-progress F744 branch and working-tree changes.
nonGoals: Copilot plugins, remote control, memory, hooks, and cloud-agent orchestration.
unresolvedQuestions: Whether Copilot later exposes a credential-safe non-interactive login status command.
Whether a later feature should refresh the Copilot model catalog dynamically.
implementationNotes: Local Copilot CLI 1.0.78 smoke discovered Aigon skills, invoked /aigon-help, accepted follow-up input, and ran aigon help in a disposable tmux session.
The live model picker confirmed Auto and named GPT, Claude, Gemini, and MAI families, with entitlement-dependent access.
copilot skill list exposed two Aigon-owned cross-agent compatibility failures: .claude/skills/aigon/SKILL.md missing standard frontmatter and .claude/commands/aft.md containing malformed quoted YAML.
Use the central model and effort launch helper; prohibit copilot -p for normal Aigon sessions.
